# Global air travel capacity and passenger traffic

Available seat-kilometers measure carrying capacity by multiplying every seat on a flight — whether filled or empty — by the distance flown. Passenger-kilometers measure traffic by multiplying only seats sold to paying passengers by the distance flown.
